subject: prd/prd-review
statement: When invoked, the reviewer shall verify its subject — a post-fold draft 000-base, or a validated amendment with its folded effect — and shall refuse any other subject naming the state and remedy, writing nothing.
rationale: wrong-subject reviews waste rounds and mislead verdicts
fit_criterion: fixture subjects: draft and amendment admitted; merged-base-outside-amendment, non-PRD, and unfolded drafts refused with remedies, zero writes
